changes: Added the anonymous vajrācārya scribe as p1. His name is lost in the lacuna, but his title, his status as paramopāsaka and his residence in the Yaśodhara-vihāra are stated. He is also the donor, because the deyadharma formula is attached to him.
Moved Śrī Yaśodharavihāra from 'place' to the scribe's residence. The colophon gives it only as where he lives ('-vihāravāsitaḥ'), not as the place of copying, so 'place' is now empty.
Era: 'saṃvat' with no era name; NS (CE ≈1609) is kept as the likely era, given the Newari script and the Patan vihāra context. The doubt is recorded in the notes.
Purpose rephrased as a pious gift (deyadharma).

purpose: pious gift (deyadharma) of a Mahāyāna lay devotee/vajrācārya
notes: The catalogue's 'Yaśodhara vajrācāya?' is a misreading: 'śrījaśodharavihāravāsitaḥ' means 'living in the Śrī Yaśodhara-vihāra' (Bu Bāhā, Patan). The vajrācārya scribe/donor's own name is lost in the lacuna after 'vrajācāryye(ṇa)'. 'pravaramahā || || yāyinaḥ' is probably 'pravaramahāyānayāyinaḥ'. The colophon says only 'saṃvat'; NS is assumed (Newari script, Newar vihāra context), and the year 729 is itself marked doubtful by the cataloguer (NS 729 = c. 1609 CE).
